instructions_to_main_agent: 1. IMPLEMENTATION STACK: Use React 19 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui components (located in frontend/src/components/ui/) with FastAPI + MongoDB backend.

2. THEME SETUP: In `frontend/src/index.css`, import `@fontsource-variable/lora` and `@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans`. Set `--font-heading: 'Lora Variable', serif` and `--font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif`. Use rich classic Islamic green tokens (#0D2E24, #135438, #F9F8F3, #C4973B).

3. GLOBAL WHATSAPP FLOATING BUTTON: Mount `<WhatsAppFloatingButton phone='08170223635' />` in `App.tsx` outside `<Routes>` so it floats consistently across ALL pages (Home, Events, Event Detail, Login, Admin). Clicking it opens WhatsApp (`https://wa.me/628170223635?text=...`) with pre-filled respectful greeting.

4. EVENT REGISTRATION FIELDS: The registration form on `/events/:id` MUST collect all 4 required fields: `nama` (Nama Lengkap), `nomor_wa` (Nomor WhatsApp), `alamat` (Alamat / Domisili), and `catatan` (Catatan / Doa / Jumlah Peserta). Save to backend and show clear instant confirmation modal/toast.

5. DONATION PROGRESS BAR: When an event has type='DONATION' or category='Donasi', show target amount (`target_dana`), collected amount (`dana_terkumpul`), donor count, and an interactive progress bar. In the Admin Dashboard, provide a quick modal/button to update `dana_terkumpul` dynamically.

6. ADMIN PANEL WITH AUTH: Build `/admin/login` and `/admin` dashboard. The admin can: (a) Add/Edit/Delete events, (b) Toggle Publish/Draft status, (c) View and export list of registered participants per event with direct 'Hubungi via WA' link, (d) Update collected donation funds, (e) Change settings (such as active mosque WhatsApp number and bank account for donations). Seed admin credentials: username `admin`, password `admin123`.

7. SEED DATA: Provide rich Indonesian realistic events in `backend/seed.py`: e.g., 'Kajian Subuh Berkah', 'Peringatan Nuzulul Qur'an & Tabligh Akbar', 'Wakaf Karpet & Renovasi Tempat Wudhu' (Donasi type), 'Santunan 100 Anak Yatim & Dhuafa' (Donasi type), 'Pelatihan Tahsin & Bahasa Arab Intensif', 'Bazar UMKM Ramadhan Masjid Kita'.
8. INDONESIAN LOCALE: Ensure all dates are rendered in Indonesian (e.g. 'Ahad, 15 Ramadhan 1447 H / 5 April 2026') and currency in Rupiah format (`Rp 25.000.000`).
9. TEST IDS: Include explicit `data-testid` on all buttons, forms, links, search filters, and table rows to guarantee 100% test pass rate.
